Veneers

Veneers have become a predictable cosmetic procedure, but the result depends on training and planning.

A smile planned step by step.

Those perfect white smiles are everywhere and have become a signature of beauty, health and wellness. But cosmetic procedures like veneers require additional training, and not all dentists are qualified to produce the result you are looking for.

At Precise Dental of Houston, we follow a stepwise protocol to make sure you get the smile of your dreams. When it comes to materials and procedure, Dr. Crouse has been creating beautiful smiles for 20 years and has the training to back it up.

Smile design training

Dr. Crouse has additional training in cosmetic dentistry and smile design.

Stepwise protocol

Every veneer plan is built in steps, so your smile is designed before it is made.

Materials explained

You hear about the materials and procedure before any treatment begins.

Dr. Lynette Crouse

Twenty years of creating beautiful smiles in Houston.

About Dr. Crouse

Dr. Crouse has been creating beautiful smiles for 20 years. She began her career as an associate at a cosmetic dental practice, then opened Precise Dental of Houston in 2004.

Her training and methods are the reason patients trust her with cosmetic work. Every treatment is built on a clear plan, with the materials and procedure explained before you begin.

  • Cosmetic dentistry
  • Veneers and smile design
  • Restorative dentistry
  • Voted Houston’s top dentist, 2014

Our team

Dr. Crouse works alongside a dedicated team, including our registered dental hygienist, so every visit feels personal and well coordinated.

What to expect on your new patient visit

We listen, we take our time, and we work together as a team to find the right solution for you.

Your first visit

Your first visit to our practice is all about getting to know you and your dental needs. You can be at ease knowing that your every concern will be taken care of. Our goal is to make you feel like you have found your new dental home.

We look at all areas of potential problems in your oral health and design a plan specific to you. We believe in giving you all the information you need to be in control of your dental health.

About 1.5 hours

Your first appointment takes approximately 1.5 hours, so there is time for every question.

Ask anything

Ask any and all questions about your dental needs. We want you to fully understand how to care for your smile.

Concierge care

We bend over backwards to meet your every dental need, including convenient scheduling and 24 hour access to our VIP text number.

Before you come in

  • Book online or call (713) 812-1712.
  • Plan for about 1.5 hours for your first appointment.
  • Bring your questions and any concerns about your smile.
  • Confirm your insurance plan when you book.
